extension.summary: Installs and updates the MediaHub skin
extension.description: Repository for the MediaHub streaming-style skin for movies and TV shows. Install the skin from Install from repository - MediaHub Repository - Look and feel - Skin, and it will be kept up to date automatically.

extension.summary: A streaming-app style skin for movies and TV shows
extension.description: MediaHub turns your Kodi movie and TV library into a modern streaming app: a rotating hero slider, network cards (Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, National Geographic, Star and 30+ more) that open a hub for that studio or network, and home rows you choose and reorder. Add titles to My List, rate them with thumbs up / down / love for better recommendations, and find more with More Like This, actor pages and a live search page. TV shows get a Disney+-style page with season tabs and movie collections get their own page, Up Next picks up where you left off, and NEW and 4K badges show what's new and in 4K. The player bar shows the title's clearart or logo with 4K, HDR, Dolby and 5.1 badges, with an Audio & Subtitles panel, a pause screen and Skip Intro / Recap / Credits buttons. There are also music screens with a now playing page, a Live TV guide, a screensaver made from your library, a "Who's watching?" profile screen, a Kids mode with a PIN and a bedtime, a shared Family List, backup and restore, large text and high contrast, and seven accent colours.
extension.disclaimer: The network card artwork is plain typography. Studio and network names are trademarks of their respective owners.

extension.news: 1.10.1 - A much smaller download: the 1.10.0 package also held a large file left over from testing. Nothing else changes. 1.10.0 - On demand: an IPTV video-on-demand playlist as TV shows (by season) and movies, without loading it into Live TV. My Channels on the home screen and a mini guide while watching Live TV. Lite mode for Apple TV, with a memory reading. Rows from any add-on, and Move or hide this row from the home screen. A Calendar of upcoming episodes, New This Week, Directed By and Marvel in Story Order rows, and New since you were last here. The long-press menu says what it is for and plays trailers. Trakt set-up, a pure black background, Library health, and German, Spanish, French, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese. 1.9.2 - Fixes Kodi closing by itself a little after start-up when Live TV has a very large channel list (such as an IPTV video-on-demand playlist): the On now row now lists only the channels you watched last. 1.9.1 - Fixes Kodi closing by itself when the MediaHub Helper was updated (or Kodi closed) while the banner trailer was playing. If Kodi ever closes on its own, MediaHub now says where it happened and offers Safe mode. 1.9.0 - A welcome setup; Top 10 rows, a silent trailer in the banner, a greeting and an On now row for Live TV; ratings badges, extras and season progress; a sleep timer, subtitle styles, Are you still watching? and an after-movie page; Kids bedtime, a shared Family List and backup / restore; large text, high contrast, reduce motion, colour from the artwork and lyrics. 1.8.0 - A start-up intro with its own sound, and a MediaHub splash while Kodi loads. 1.7.0 - Trailer previews in the home rows, Because You Watched, mood rows and Coming Soon; Finish by, chapters, intro memory and Night / Dialogue sound modes in the player; people search, a mic key, Surprise me and Movies filter chips; profile avatars, Your year and downloads; seasonal themes and animated network cards. 1.6.1 - Fixed "Update failed" when pressing Update now: the update is now handed to Kodi's own installer. 1.6.0 - New player bar with the title's clearart or logo and 4K / HDR / Dolby / 5.1 badges, an Audio & Subtitles panel, Skip Recap and Skip Credits, NEW and 4K badges, collection pages, a MediaHub screensaver, music screens and Live TV.

extension.summary: Up Next, My List, thumbs and recommendations for the MediaHub skin
extension.description: Runs in the background for the MediaHub skin. It works out Up Next (the next episode of every TV show you are part-way through, with the following episodes queued when you play one), keeps My List, stores your thumbs up / down as the library's own "my rating", and ranks Recommended For You and More Like This from them. It also fills in collection pages, works out the NEW badges, lists the audio and subtitle tracks for the player's Audio & Subtitles panel, runs the start-up intro and the MediaHub screensaver, plays trailer previews in the home rows, keeps Finish by, intro memory and the sound modes going while you watch, finds people when you search, picks a Surprise, works out Your year, downloads titles to watch offline and checks for MediaHub updates. It also reads an IPTV playlist for the On demand pages, keeps My Channels, looks up upcoming episodes on TVmaze for the Calendar, turns Lite mode on when memory runs low, and checks the library's health. If Kodi ever closes on its own, it says where that happened and offers Safe mode.
extension.news: 1.7.1 - A much smaller download: the 1.7.0 package also held a large file left over from testing. 1.7.0 - On demand (an IPTV video-on-demand playlist as shows and movies), My Channels, Lite mode, the add-on folder picker for custom rows, Move or hide this row, the Calendar (TVmaze), New This Week, Directed By and Marvel in Story Order, New since you were last here, Play trailer, Library health, and translations. 1.6.3 - After Kodi closes on its own, the log of the next start holds the last lines Kodi wrote before it closed, and the screen, view and memory in use at the last few places, so an uploaded log shows what happened. 1.6.2 - Check for updates works again: it said "Couldn't check - are you online?" because the download site sends its list of versions compressed. 1.6.1 - Fixes Kodi closing by itself when the helper was updated (or Kodi closed) while the banner trailer was playing: stopping the helper no longer hangs until Kodi kills it. Notices when Kodi closed on its own, says where it happened, and offers Safe mode (no trailer previews or moving effects). 1.6.0 - Sleep timer, subtitle styles, Are you still watching?, the after-movie page, the banner trailer, Remove from Continue Watching, ratings badges, extras, Mark season watched, Kids bedtime, the Family List, backup / restore and the text size setting. 1.5.0 - Plays the start-up intro and its sound, and puts the MediaHub splash in place. 1.4.0 - Trailer previews, Because You Watched, Coming Soon, Finish by, intro memory, sound modes, people search, Surprise me, avatars, Your year and downloads. 1.3.1 - Update now no longer fails: it hands the update to Kodi and finishes after Kodi restarts the helper. 1.3.0 - Collections, NEW badges, the audio / subtitle track list and the MediaHub screensaver.
